blurb: Cape Cod Xplore offers detailed guides and listings for boat rentals including center consoles, pontoons, skiffs, and fishing charters in Cape Cod, Plymouth, Martha's Vineyard, and nearby locations. They provide pricing, boat details, rental requirements, and contact information for various rental companies and charter services. The site also includes local event information and ferry service details.
extraNote: Full refund up to 5 days prior for some rentals · Cancellations 48 hours or more in advance or due to weather are fully refunded · Gas fuel costs usually not included and paid separately · Boats not allowed out in hazardous weather conditions · Damage deposit $750 for some rentals
